text: dsh-overleaf（DSH 插件，web 客户端）：将多个 Overleaf 项目通过 OverleafMCP 接入 DSH。插件在启动时读取项目 ID 和共享 Git token，生成 MCP 服务配置，并通过 stdio 启动 OverleafMCP，将其工具提供给 DSH；它还向模型提示先选择项目，并要求写入操作提供提交说明。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Overleaf 项目的用户；需要配置 Overleaf Git token 和项目 ID。

dsh-overleaf connects multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP. It reads project IDs and a shared Git token, writes MCP configuration, launches the service over stdio, and exposes its tools to DSH. A system prompt guides project selection and commit messages for writes.

有没有办法把几个 Overleaf 工程接到同一个 DSH 会话？
我想让 DSH 的模型先列出项目，再选择要处理的那个
希望模型修改 Overleaf 文档时通过 Git 提交并写明提交信息
How can I expose my Overleaf projects as tools in DSH?
I need the assistant to choose an Overleaf project before working on it.
Can DSH connect to several Overleaf projects through one MCP server?
I want Overleaf edits to include a commit message when they are written back.
dsh-overleaf 的「多项目配置」功能：将配置中的每个项目 ID 与共享 Git token 组成 MCP 项目条目，供 OverleafMCP 使用。
dsh-overleaf 的「启动 Overleaf 工具服务」功能：以 MCP stdio 方式启动 OverleafMCP，并把服务工具接入 DSH；启动错误会中止加载。
dsh-overleaf 的「项目选择提示」功能：向模型提示先调用项目列表工具，并在后续调用中沿用所选项目 ID。
dsh-overleaf 的「生成本地配置」功能：首次启动时创建空配置文件，并写出供 MCP 服务读取的项目配置文件。
dsh-overleaf 使用前须知：需在本地配置共享 Git token 和项目 ID；配置读取一次发生在启动时，改动后需重启 DSH 才会重新生成 MCP 配置（见 index.js:39-53）。

dsh-overleaf README · dsh-overleaf：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Connect multiple Overleaf projects to [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) through [@fly233338/overleaf-mcp](https://github.com/fly233338/overleaf-mcp).

`dsh-overleaf` installs [@fly233338/overleaf-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fly233338/overleaf-mcp) as an npm dependency, starts it through MCP stdio, and exposes its tools to DSH. The OverleafMCP source is not copied into this project.

dsh-overleaf README · Features：Browse and read files from multiple Overleaf projects, inspect document sections and section content, write files or sections back to Overleaf through Git, and use the DSH MCP Client provided by the host. **Based on my experience, it is especially useful in the following scenarios: understanding an entire LaTeX project, automatically fixing LaTeX compilation errors, and unifying terminology and symbols throughout the document.**

dsh-overleaf README · Requirements：- DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` or `0.2.x` (verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node.js `22.19.0` or newer.
- An Overleaf Git integration token.

dsh-overleaf README · Install：If the DSH CLI is installed and available on `PATH`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-overleaf
dsh web
```

From a DSH source checkout:

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-overleaf

The npm installation command becomes available after this package is published.

dsh-overleaf README · Configure：The plugin stores `dsh-overleaf.config.json` under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-overleaf/`. If `DSH_HOME` is not set, it uses `~/.dsh/dsh-overleaf/`. The directory and file are created on startup when missing. Fill in one shared token and one project ID per line:

```json
{
  "gitToken": "your-overleaf-git-token",
  "projectIds": [
    "project-id-a",

dsh-overleaf README · Configure：Get project IDs from the `<id>` in the Overleaf project URL. Create the Git token under [Overleaf Account Settings → Git Integration](https://docs.overleaf.com/integrations-and-add-ons/git-integration-and-github-synchronization/git/git-integration-authentication-tokens).

Restart DSH after editing the file. The plugin reads it once at startup and generates the internal `.dsh-overleaf.projects.json` OverleafMCP project configuration in the same directory. Do not edit the generated file.
dsh-overleaf README · Configure：The plugin does not read `.env` and does not require Overleaf environment variables.

dsh-overleaf README · Use with the model：Tell the model which project to handle:

```text
Please work on Overleaf project project-id-a and read its main.tex.
```

The model first calls `mcp__overleaf__list_projects`, then passes the selected ID as `projectName` to subsequent Overleaf tools. Write operations require an explicit `commitMessage` and push a Git commit to Overleaf.

Keep the token out of public source repositories and published package contents.
dsh-overleaf README · Scope：The current version supports multiple Overleaf projects through one MCP tool group. It does not compile documents, review PDFs, or automate a browser.

dsh-overleaf README · dsh-overleaf：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

通过 [@fly233338/overleaf-mcp](https://github.com/fly233338/overleaf-mcp) 将多个 Overleaf 项目连接到 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。

`dsh-overleaf` 将 [@fly233338/overleaf-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fly233338/overleaf-mcp) 作为 npm 依赖安装，通过 MCP stdio 启动它，并将其工具暴露给 DSH。本项目不复制 OverleafMCP 的源代码。
dsh-overleaf README · 功能：支持浏览和读取多个 Overleaf 项目中的文件、检查文档章节和章节内容、通过 Git 将文件或章节写回 Overleaf，并使用 DSH 宿主提供的 MCP Client。**根据我的体验，尤其适用于以下场景：理解整个 LaTeX 项目、自动修复 LaTeX 编译错误、全文统一术语/符号。**

dsh-overleaf README · 要求：- DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` 或 `0.2.x`（已针对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证）。
- Node.js `22.19.0` 或更高版本。
- 一个 Overleaf Git 集成 token。

dsh-overleaf README · 安装：如果 DSH CLI 已安装并且可以从 `PATH` 使用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-overleaf
dsh web
```

从 DSH 源码目录安装：

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-overleaf

本项目发布后即可使用 npm 安装命令。

dsh-overleaf README · 配置：插件将 `dsh-overleaf.config.json` 保存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-overleaf/` 中。如果未设置 `DSH_HOME`，则使用 `~/.dsh/dsh-overleaf/`。目录和文件不存在时会在启动时创建。每行填写一个项目 ID，并使用同一个 token：

```json
{
  "gitToken": "your-overleaf-git-token",
  "projectIds": [
    "project-id-a",

项目 ID 可以从 Overleaf 项目 URL 中的 `<id>` 获取。请在 [Overleaf Account Settings → Git Integration](https://docs.overleaf.com/integrations-and-add-ons/git-integration-and-github-synchronization/git/git-integration-authentication-tokens) 中创建 Git token。

dsh-overleaf README · 配置：编辑配置文件后重启 DSH。插件只在启动时读取配置，并在同一目录生成 OverleafMCP 的内部配置文件 `.dsh-overleaf.projects.json`。不要编辑生成的文件。

插件不读取 `.env`，也不要求设置 Overleaf 环境变量。

dsh-overleaf README · 与模型一起使用：告诉模型要处理哪个项目：

```
Please work on Overleaf project project-id-a and read its main.tex.
```

模型会先调用 `mcp__overleaf__list_projects`，然后在后续 Overleaf 工具调用中将选中的项目 ID 作为 `projectName`。写入操作必须提供明确的 `commitMessage`，并会通过 Git 向 Overleaf 提交。

请勿将 token 提交到公开源码仓库或发布到 npm 包中。
dsh-overleaf README · 范围：当前版本通过一个 MCP 工具组支持多个 Overleaf 项目。不支持编译文档、审阅 PDF 或自动化浏览器。
